title: Monthly budget sync
text:
Raj: This is the monthly budget sync. Let's go team by team.
Ella: Marketing is on track. We moved some of the events money into the video project, as agreed.
Raj: Thanks. Engineering?
Tom: We are over on cloud costs by about eight percent. The new staging environment runs all day.
Raj: Can it shut down at night?
Tom: Yes. We can schedule it to stop in the evening and start at seven. That should bring us back in line.
Raj: Please do that this week. Support?
Ella: Support is under, because the second hire starts next month instead of this month.
Raj: Good. Then the only real issue is cloud costs, and we have a plan.
Tom: One more thing. The software licences renew in June, and the vendor is raising prices.
Raj: How much?
Tom: About twelve percent. I would like to look at alternatives before we commit.
Raj: Agreed. Bring two options to the next sync.
Ella: Should we flag the licence increase to the leadership team now?
Raj: Yes, I will mention it in my weekly note. Thanks, both of you.
